Q1.baseline: Frangi/ridge/edge + morphology on project images with original-image holdout
Q1.author_route: DeepLabV3+ transfer learning using 117 external images plus project images
alternatives: small U-Net/DeepLab head with frozen backbone after clean project-image split
component-feature classifier when labels are scarce
not_recommended: training on all project images then reporting all-project metrics as test
augmentation after leakage as a remedy
Q1.why_select: deep model is plausible only if clean project holdout demonstrates gain; reported numbers lack that guarantee
Q1.switch_condition: promote DeepLabV3+ after source-grouped untouched project test and calibration/ablation

Q2.baseline: DBSCAN/topology fragments + fixed P=pi*D + linear/robust fit + reject
Q2.author_route: DBSCAN fragments, largest seed, fixed-period model-driven iterative merge/refit
not_recommended: free-period nonlinear search without geometry need
merge thresholds tuned on evaluation images
Q2.why_select: strong physical period and fragment-to-model loop directly address broken masks
Q2.switch_condition: use more flexible clustering only if fragment density/topology varies beyond DBSCAN assumptions

Q3.baseline: ordered detrended profile + canonical JRC + equal spacing; compare sampling under one common reference
Q3.author_route: equal/adaptive/keypoint sampling; keypoint selected by R2/RMSE
alternatives: multi-objective/Pareto choice with RMSE and tail errors
not_recommended: declaring a universal winner when metrics disagree
Q3.why_select: keypoint has best R2/RMSE but worse tail-outlier count, so objective must be explicit
Q3.switch_condition: choose equal sampling if tail robustness/±5% violations dominate, keypoint if RMSE/R2 dominate

Q4.baseline: deterministic plane geometry + compatibility edge score + thresholded graph registry + component replay + feasible coverage placement
Q4.author_route: weighted similarity → threshold graph → hotspot uncertainty → three-hole recommendation
not_recommended: calling one weighted score calibrated probability
deriving a four-hole component from an edge registry that contains only one edge
Q4.why_select: transparent graph replay is mandatory before probabilistic embellishment
Q4.switch_condition: upgrade to Bayesian/EIG only with labels/likelihood/posterior update and edge/component consistency
